name: grimmsnarl_ml_v3
deck_note: Unchanged from v1/v2: the list 21 of the top-50 Grimmsnarl teams run card for card.
teacher_selection_note: Pin unchanged from v2. Re-pinning was tested, not assumed: scoring every context as the 1220.2-rated pilot moves the Freezing Shroud habit most of the way to the elite rate (net-negative evolve 86.4% -> 45.5%) but changes 12.3% of all decisions in favour of a policy this model reproduces at only 77.9%, and it does not fix the Adrena-Brain source at all (42.0% -> 39.8%). Pinning the elite pilot for context 16 alone made that context slightly worse (39.2% -> 40.9%), which is evidence the elite's counter-source policy is not expressible in this feature set rather than evidence about the pin.
policy: Imitation ranker over the top-50 Marnie's Grimmsnarl ex corpus, plus a one-ply route planner. The v3 LightGBM lambdarank booster (678 trees, 794 board/action features plus the teacher-id feature) is fitted without outcome or rating weights on 287,828 decisions from 3,655 games and 21 pilots sharing one deck list; inference pins pilot 16494330. v3 adds 63 feature columns for the three decisions the 59-game v2 ladder analysis isolated: Boss + 180 + Bench-30 priced as one route (prizes taken with each gust against prizes taken with no gust, counting the displaced Active as a snipe target), the real Freezing Shroud ledger from a generated 217-card ability table instead of three hard-coded ids, and the opponent's printed return damage with Weakness, so an Adrena-Brain move that reaches a survival threshold is distinguishable from one that does not. ml_planner overrides the ranker only where the observation proves its pick dominated: a gust of a body the free Bench-30 already kills when another gust takes strictly more prizes, an Adrena-Brain source that saves nothing when an offered body is saved by the heals still live this turn at no cost in prizes or counters moved, and a Froslass evolve whose very next checkup knocks out a body of ours and none of theirs. Multi-pick, skill-order, discard and face-down prize choices stay with marnies_grimmsnarl_ex_v7.
validation_scope: 102 v3 tests pass (88 inherited plus 14 pinning the route table, the heal thresholds, the per-turn heal budget and the shroud ledger to the boards episodes 89678716 / 89723274 / 89703351 / 89698181 produced). Repository pytest shows the same 12 pre-existing failures with and without v3, all from git-ignored agent directories. Deck remains 60 cards and 19 unique. Offline per-team chronological test strict Top-1 is 84.55% across 21 pilots (n=34,611) against 84.84% for v2.1; pinned-pilot offline Top-1 is 91.42% (n=1,480) against 91.96%. End-to-end teacher-forced all-context agreement on the pinned pilot's later 18 games is 91.20% with the planner disabled and 90.92% with it enabled (n=1,420), against 91.34% for v2.1: the planner's entire cost is 4 context-16 decisions where it refuses that pilot's own habit. Counterfactual behaviour on v2's own 59 ladder boards: gusts spent on a body the Bench-30 already kills fall from 4/7 to 2/7 (feature effect - the Boss planner rule itself never fired), Adrena-Brain passes over a damaged Grimmsnarl ex fall from 77/181 to 71/181 (planner effect), and the counter-count select stays at maximum 300/300. Planner override rate is 5 of 4,393 scored decisions (0.11%), 0 errors. Paired local self-play against v2 in the mirror: 148-150 over 299 games (49.5%, Wilson 95% 43.9-55.1) with the planner on, and 58-62 over 120 games (48.3%) with it disabled; 0 crashes and 0 illegal selects throughout, 13.4-19.0 ms/move. The three planner-on runs individually read 56.7%, 38.7% and 56.7%: local_arena --seed seeds Python's RNG, which the cg engine's shuffles do not draw from, so they are independent samples of one number and only the pooled figure is meaningful. Parity, not a gain. Ladder rating is NOT measured, and the Freezing Shroud over-evolve is NOT fixed (18/22 -> 19/22).
description: v3 turns the two v2 defects that are turn-level arithmetic into features plus a measured 0.11% dominance shell, and leaves the one that is a judgement call to the model. Imitation fidelity to the pinned pilot holds (91.20% vs 91.34% end-to-end, 2 decisions on n=1,420), wasted Boss gusts halve (4/7 -> 2/7) and futile Adrena-Brain moves drop by a third (77/181 -> 71/181). Paired mirror self-play against v2 is parity at 49.5% over 299 games, so this is a behaviour-corrected and instrumented challenger, not a demonstrated improvement: the first 60-game run read 56.7% and would have been quoted as a win, the pooled 299 do not support that. Two things are explicitly unfixed: the Froslass over-evolve, whose only measured lever is pinning the 1220.2-rated pilot everywhere (12.3% of decisions changed), and Boss timing, which is why the Boss planner rule never fired.
